title: NAFEMS R0027 Test 7 pressurized-cylinder secondary creep
purpose: Promote the global implicit creep procedure from homogeneous material paths toward a public structure-level equilibrium and stress-redistribution benchmark without overstating the current mesh-convergence evidence.
physics: Plane-strain thick cylinder under constant internal pressure with Mises secondary power-law creep

source.organization: NAFEMS; publicly reproduced by Dassault Systemes SIMULIA
source.title: Test 7: Axisymmetric - pressurized cylinder, secondary creep

execution.evidence: The automated fast gate checks the published radial, hoop and axial steady-state stress solution. The structural API executes the published elastic-preload then 1000-hour creep path on a three-dimensional plane-strain quarter sector, but is deliberately excluded from the regular CI promotion set until mesh/time convergence and runtime are acceptable.

observables: Radial, hoop and axial stress versus physical radius.
Final global residual norm and wall equilibrium.
acceptance: The dependency-free analytical oracle reproduces the published five-radius stress table.
A promoted structural result must demonstrate radial, angular and time-increment convergence rather than pass on one selected mesh.
The elastic pressure preload and subsequent held-pressure creep step remain separate scientific procedures.
Runtime must be suitable for a repeatable scheduled benchmark before this card is promoted to external structural verification.
limitations: The current structural route extrudes the axisymmetric reference into a thin three-dimensional quarter sector because the trusted global creep consumer is three-dimensional.
The current tetrahedral, faceted-sector discretization has not yet met the proposed radial and axial stress tolerances under a documented refinement study.
This card therefore validates the analytical contract and executable route, not final structural agreement with NAFEMS R0027.
